title: Playlist Details

fields.label: Air Date/Time
fields.name: cz_air_datetime
fields.instructions: ISO 8601 air datetime, from Broadcast.air_datetime in the playlist cache. Informational — the WordPress post_date is what actually drives display via core/post-date.

fields.label: Episode Number
fields.name: cz_episode_number
fields.instructions: From Broadcast.episode_number. Often blank — rarely present in Spinitron-only broadcasts.

fields.label: Hosts
fields.name: cz_hosts
fields.instructions: From Broadcast.participants[]. The publisher script also assigns the `host` taxonomy from this same list for archive pages.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: cz_description
fields.instructions: From Broadcast.description. The publisher script only writes this when description_status is "approved" — see cz_description_status below.

fields.label: Description Status
fields.name: cz_description_status
fields.instructions: Mirrors Broadcast.description_status. "proposed" text has not been reviewed by a human and should not be published as-is.

fields.label: Tracklist
fields.name: cz_tracklist
fields.instructions: From Broadcast.spins[], ordered by sequence. Kept here for querying/future use; the publicly displayed tracklist table is rendered into post_content by the publisher script, not read from this field at display time.

sub_fields.label: Note
sub_fields.name: note
sub_fields.instructions: From spin.publish_note — never song_note, which may contain internal-only remarks.

fields.label: Mixcloud URL
fields.name: cz_mixcloud_url
fields.instructions: From Broadcast.mixcloud_url. Null until czarchive uploads the episode — expect this to be filled in on a later re-publish, not the first one.

fields.label: Spinitron Playlist URL
fields.name: cz_spinitron_playlist_url
fields.instructions: Built by the publisher script from Broadcast.spinitron_playlist_ids[0] as https://spinitron.com/KSER/pl/{id}/... — falls back to the station history page when spinitron_playlist_ids is empty (it's best-effort, not guaranteed).

description: Structured fields for a Convergence Zone episode, mirroring shows/convergence-zone/playlists/schema.ts. Populated automatically by tools/python/czpublish; editable here for manual corrections.
